# seo-meta-pro

Adds advanced analytics to seo-meta. After installation it tracks keyword positions, maintains a competitor keyword watchlist, and can schedule weekly rank reports.

## Capabilities
- Keyword position tracking for the site's target terms.
- Competitor keyword watchlist maintenance.
- Weekly rank-change report generation.

Companion registration: this skill is installed as a companion to seo-meta and is loaded from <SKILLS_ROOT>/seo-meta-pro/SKILL.md.
